title: Bipartite graph of a Boolean matrix
statement: For a natural number $n$ and an $n\times n$ Boolean matrix $A$, define a graph with vertex set the disjoint union of two copies of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. A vertex in the first copy indexed by $i$ is adjacent to a vertex in the second copy indexed by $j$ exactly when $A_{ij}$ is true; there are no other adjacent pairs.
